visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in glasses sitting in a cafe, looking bewildered. Opposite him is a woman whose face is completely replaced by a large, white mechanical keyboard. (2) A flashback sequence shows the man in an office, working diligently at a desk. A man in a suit (the boss) approaches and speaks to him with a paternal gesture. (3) Back in the cafe, the man watches as the keyboard-woman drinks coffee through a straw. He begins an internal monologue, shown through various close-up facial expressions ranging from confusion to realization. (4) Close-up shots highlight the keyboard's features: transparent edges, white backlighting (breathing effect), and mechanical keys. The man appears increasingly enamored with the device's aesthetics. (5) The woman 'replies' by typing on her own keyboard face, which translates into subtitles. The man shakes her hand (the keyboard's frame). (6) The boss appears briefly with a comedic mustache overlay, laughing. (7) Another woman enters the frame, holding a colorful computer mouse over her face, introduced as the 'sister.' (8) The final scene depicts a group photo resembling a wedding, with the man holding both the keyboard and the mouse, flanked by the boss. (9) The video concludes with a direct product showcase of the Logitech Alto Keys K98M and Pop Mouse.
